weighting: Equal registered tasks; mean macro NLL and within-task accuracy over all cells; old includes old-only; new uses joint cells only; cohorts pooled 3:1.
limitations: OOF folds share training supports; repeated tasks share physical IDs; occurrences are not independent samples.
Per-class NLL and physical predicted class exist in full trace; compact preserves only three group NLL values.
View-specific vectors, within-physical orbit variation, cyclic margins, pairwise interclass distances and full OOF logits are not recorded.
Covariance trace is aligned between-physical residual, not direct within-physical view information.
K1 has no heldout OOF; these diagnostics cannot establish query/generalization performance or an information-theoretic identifiability limit.
